headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low as Iran attribution adds to Gulf energy stress
body: NQ futures are closed for the weekend. U.S. President Donald Trump said Iran was probably responsible for the Saudi East-West pipeline attack, while the pipeline shutdown and Houthi control of Perim keep energy and shipping risk severe. Friday's Nasdaq rebound and constructive breadth conflict with that shock, but no live NQ path can confirm persistent directional structure.
